connect_agents.allow_spending_label: U ogolow wakiillada inay codsadaan iibsi (weli waxaa loo baahan yahay ansixintaada)
connect_agents.approvals_intro: Iibsi uu wakiil codsaday. Wax lama iibsan weli. Faahfaahinta waxay ka timid EasyPost, ma aha wakiilka.
connect_agents.clients_intro: Macaamiisha MCP ee soo socda ayaa laga helay kombayutarkan. Ku xidhiddu waxay ku darsataa gelin faylkooda qaabeynta; faylka jira horta waa la kaydiyaa, waxna kale isma beddelaan.
connect_agents.confirm_spend_body:
Iibso {carrier} {amount} {currency} habka {mode}?

Tani waxay ku baxaysaa lacag dhab ah haddii habka wax-soo-saarku firfircoon yahay.
connect_agents.manual_intro: Macmiil kasta oo aan kor ku qornayn, kan ku dar qaabeyntiisa MCP. Inta badan waxay isticmaalaan “mcpServers”; VS Code wuxuu isticmaalaa “servers”.
connect_agents.no_clients: Macmiil MCP lama helin. Isticmaal habaynta gacanta ee hoose.
connect_agents.relay_config_label: Ku dhaji tan qaabaynta MCP ee macmiilkaaga AI. Macmiilada badankood waxay ku dhex geliyaan servers-ka hoos "mcpServers"; VS Code wuxuu isticmaalaa "servers".
connect_agents.relay_enable_label: Shid gelitaanka fog (iyada oo loo marayo rilaay ammaan ah)
connect_agents.relay_group: Ku xidh macmiil AI ah (adigoo isticmaalaya relay ammaan ah)
connect_agents.relay_intro: App-kani wuxuu la xidhiidhaa macaamiisha AI isagoo adeegsanaya relay ammaan ah: wuxuu sameeyaa xiriir dibadda u socda oo keliya — waxba kuma sugayaan xiriirrada soo galaya Mac-kaaga. Relay-ku waligiis ma arko furahaaga EasyPost, mana socodsiiyo qalab; qalab kastaa halkan buu ku socdaa, iibsigana weli wuxuu u baahan yahay ogolaanshahaaga hoose.
connect_agents.relay_optin_intro: Si ikhtiyaari ah, kaga gaadh barnaamijkan kombiyuutar kale, ama kaydka (client) aan aqbalin waxaan URL mooyee, iyada oo loo marayo rilaay ammaan ah. Ikhtiyaarka maxalliga ah ee kore waa mid caadi ah (default) oo aan u baahnayn shabakad. Rilaayku wuxuu sameeyaa xiriir dibadda u socda oo keliya, weligiis ma arko furahaaga EasyPost, welina ma hawlgeliyo qalab (tool); iibsigu weli wuxuu u baahan yahay ogolaanshahaaga hoose.
connect_agents.relay_regenerate_confirm_: Tan waxay isla markiiba ka go'isaa xiriirka macmiil kasta oo AI ah oo isticmaalaya token-ka hadda jira. Waxaad u baahan doontaa inaad qaabaynta cusub ku dhajiso macmiil kasta. Ma sii wadaa?
Dib u soo saar token-ka lammaanaynta?
connect_agents.relay_status_running: La xidhay — macaamiisha AI waxay gaari karaan app-kan intuu furan yahay.
connect_agents.relay_status_stopped: Lama xidhin. Kor u shid "Enable AI agent access" si aad u bilowdo.
connect_agents.relay_token_warning: Ula dhaqan qaabaynta tan sida furaha sirta ah: intuu app-kani furan yahay, token-ku wuxuu u oggolaadaa macmiil AI ah inuu akhriyo xogtaada rarka iyo inuu barbardhigo qiimaha rarka (waligiis lacag ma bixiyo). Dib u soo saar haddii uu goorna soo baxo.
connect_agents.relay_url_form_label: Ama, macmiil aan aqbalin wax aan URL ahayn (headers ma leh):
connect_agents.safety_explainer: Wakiilladu waxay akhrisan karaan xogtaada, xaqiijin karaan cinwaannada oo isbarbardhigi karaan qiimayaasha iyagoo aan wax weydiin. Waligood si toos ah wax ma iibsan karaan: iibsigu wuxuu noqonayaa codsi aad halkan ku ansixinayso, faahfaahintuna waxay ka timaadaa EasyPost, ma aha waxa uu wakiilku sheegay. Wax kasta oo ka sarreeya xadadkan waa la diidayaa halkii loo gudbin lahaa ansixin. U dhig 0 si aad xadka u saarto.
connect_agents.title: Ku xidh wakiilada AI
connect_agents.unsupported_body: Ku xidhidhinta wakiilada AI ee MCP hadda waxaa lagu taageeraa oo keliya nooca si toos ah loo soo dejiyo ee Easy-Post Desktop. Waxay u baahan tahay in app kale uu ka bilaabo hawl caawimaad rakibaaddan oo uu wax ku qoro faylasha qaabeynta barnaamijyada kale, xirmada Microsoft Store-na labadaas si lagu kalsoonaan karo ma qaban karto.
connect_agents.unsupported_link: Nooca si toos ah loo soo dejiyo wuxuu ka helayaa easy-post.spencerfields.com. Wax kasta oo kale si isku mid ah ayey uga shaqeeyaan labada nooc.
connect_agents.verified_note: Faahfaahintan waxaa dib looga soo qaaday EasyPost iyadoo la isticmaalayo kaliya aqoonsiyada uu wakiilku bixiyay. Haddii aysan ahayn waxa aad filaysay, diid.

create_shipment.missing_name_body: Shixnadkani wuxuu tallaabsadaa xudduud caalami ah. Baaninta caadiyada dartay, shirkadaha gaadiidku waxay u baahan yihiin magac ama shirkad ku yaal labada cinwaan, kan laga soo diray iyo kan loo diray — marka hore mid uga dar mid kasta Buugga Cinwaannada.

hts_lookup.intro: Raadi koodhadka Jadwalka Canshuurta La Isku Waafajiyay (HTS) ee baayaninta caadiyaadka, adigoo isticmaalaya xogta toos ah ee Guddiga Ganacsiga Caalamiga ah ee Mareykanka. insurance.missing_info_body: Koodhka raadraaca, shirkadda gaadiidka, iyo qiimaha waa lagama maarmaan.
insurance.not_enabled_body: Akoonkan EasyPost looma shaqaysiin iibsashada caymiska gaarka ah. Weydiiso taageerada EasyPost inay shaqaysiiso, ama caymiska ku dar markaad summada iibsanayso, taasoo aan u baahnayn ogolaansho gaar ah.

key_check.prod_in_test_body: Furaha loo geliyey sida furaha tijaabada waa furaha wax-soo-saarka toos ah. Dirista wax-soo-saarka waxay u baahan tahay shatiga. Ku geli meesha wax-soo-saarka, ama halkan ku dhaji furaha tijaabo si aad wax walba u tijaabiso lacag la'aan.
key_check.test_in_prod_body: Furaha loo geliyey sida furaha wax-soo-saarka waa furaha tijaabo, oo aan iibsan karin sumado dhab ah. Geli furaha wax-soo-saarka, ama tan ku dar sida furahaaga tijaabada.
key_check.unverifiable_body: Kama xaqiijin karin furahaas EasyPost. Hubi furaha iyo xiriirkaaga internetka, ka dibna isku day mar kale.
license_gate.buy_soon_body: Iibsashada onlaynka weli lama heli karo. Fadlan mar dambe soo eeg.
license_gate.invalid_body: Furaha shatiga lama aqoonsan. Hubi inaad ka koobiday furaha oo dhan iimaylkaaga iibsiga, ama la xidhiidh taageerada.
license_gate.offline_body: Furahaagu waa sax, sidaas darteed waad sii wadi kartaa. Hadda lama xaqiijin karin tirada kombayutarada; si toos ah ayaan mar kale isku dayi doonnaa. Haddii ilaa {date} weli la gaari waayo, waxaa lagu weydiisan doonaa inaad mar kale firfircooniso.
license_gate.release_body: Shatigaagu wuxuu daboolayaa {seats} kombayutar oo dhammaantood la isticmaalayo. Dooro mid aad sii deyso si kombayutarkan uu meeshiisa u qaato. Kombayutarka la sii daayay waxaa laga codsan doonaa inuu mar kale firfircoonaado marka xiga ee la shido.
license_gate.release_title: Shatigan waa horeba ugu shaqeeyaa dhammaan kombayutaradiisa
license_gate.subtitle: Habka tijaabada waa bilaash. Si aad u dirto sumado dhab ah adigoo isticmaalaya furaha wax-soo-saarka EasyPost, dhaqaajii shati adigoo isticmaalaya furaha ku jira iimaylka iibkaaga.
license_gate.title: Fur dirista wax-soo-saarka

pair_mobile.error_no_production_key: Ku dar furaha API-ga EasyPost ee wax-soo-saarka Dejinta si aad u isku xidho appka mobilka la socda.
pair_mobile.error_server: Adeegga isku xirka wuxuu soo celiyay khalad. Fadlan isku day mar kale wax yar ka dib.

pair_mobile.intro: Ku xidh Easy-Post Mobile Companion si aad uga soconto oo uga maamusho shixnadaha taleefanka. Aaladaha mobilka ayaa dhawaan ka heli doona App Store iyo Google Play; koodhka halkan laga sameeyo ayaa isku xidhi doona isla marka ay diyaar noqdaan.
pair_mobile.needs_key: Ku dar furaha API-ga EasyPost ee wax-soo-saarka Dejinta si aad u isku xidho appka mobilka la socda.
pair_mobile.needs_production: Isku xirku wuxuu u baahan yahay nooca wax-soo-saarka. Kici shatiga wax-soo-saarka si aad u isticmaasho appka mobilka la socda.
pair_mobile.qr_group: Iskaan si aad u isku xirto
pair_mobile.security_note: Furaha API-ga wax-soo-saarka weligiis kuma muuqdo koodhka mana lagu kaydiyo qaab la akhrin karo. Samaynta koodh cusub waxay bedeshaa kii hore.
pair_mobile.steps:
1. Ku rakib Easy-Post Mobile Companion taleefanka.
2. Fur app-ka oo dooro Isku xir.
3. Iskaan koodhka kore.
pair_mobile.title: Isku xir aaladda mobilka

settings.forget_keys_confirm_body: Ma ka saarayaa labada furaha API ee kombayutarkan? Meel kale looma diro, sidaa darteed waa inaad mar kale ku dhajiso ka hor inta aanad wax dirin.
settings.label_applies_note: Waxay khusaysaa dirista cusub, oo ay ku jiraan kooxaha. Xamuulyahannadu waxay go'aamiyaan cabbirka sumadda marka la abuuro dirista, sidaas darteed tani ma beddesho sumadaha horay loo iibsaday.
settings.label_caveat_ups: UPS wuxuu soo celiyaa 4x7 haddii aan si kale loo cayimin. 4x6 wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa ZPL kaliya, marka laga reebo haddii Taageerada EasyPost ay furto 4x6 PNG akoonkaaga (dirista gudaha oo keliya). 4x7 iyo 4x8 waa sumad 4x6 oo lagu daray meel bannaan.
settings.label_caveat_zpl_only: LaserShip iyo OnTrac waxay taageeraan 4x6 iyo 4x8 ZPL kaliya.
settings.language_restart_note: Dib u bilaw abka si isbeddelka luqadda si buuxda u shaqeeyo.
settings.sheet_needs_png_note: Xaashiyaha calaamadaha waxaa laga sameeyaa sawirro calaamad, sidaas darteed qaabka waxaa laga beddelay {format} loona rogay PNG. Calaamadaha {format} laguma dhigi karo xaashi.
settings.support_blurb: Easy-Post Desktop waa il furan waxaana sameeyay hal qof. Haddii ay faa'iido lahayd, xiddig lagu dhajiyo kaydka wuxuu ka caawiyaa dadka kale inay helaan.

setup_wizard.subtitle: Ku dheji furayaasha API-ga EasyPost hoos. Waxaa si ammaan ah loogu kaydiyaa maamulaha xogta xaqiijinta (credential manager) ee nidaamka hawlgalka mishiinkan — waligeed qoraal cad kuma jiraan, mana loo dirin meel aan ahayn API-ga EasyPost.

store_unlock.buy_in_store_body: Microsoft Store waxay furtay bogga Easy-Post Desktop. Halkaas ka iibso Furitaanka wax-soo-saarka, ka dibna halkan ku soo noqo oo dooro Soo celi.
store_unlock.enter_code_invalid_body: Hubi koodhka oo isku day mar kale. Haddii dhibaatadu sii socoto, la xidhiidh taageerada.
store_unlock.enter_code_prompt: Ku dhaji koodhkaaga furitaanka si aad u daarto habka wax-soo-saarka.
store_unlock.error_body: Wax baa qaldan gaadhista Microsoft Store. Fadlan hubi xidhiidhkaaga oo mar kale isku day.
store_unlock.multi_seat_link: Ma shatiyeynaysaa in ka badan hal kombuyuutar, ama koox? Hel shati kuraas-badan
store_unlock.restore_button: Horay ma u iibsatay? Soo celi
store_unlock.restore_none_body: Ma jirin Furitaan wax-soo-saar oo laga helay xisaabtan Microsoft. Haddii aad hadda iibsatay, sug daqiiqad oo mar kale isku day, oo hubi inaad ku gashay Store-ka xisaabtii aad ku iibsatay.
store_unlock.subtitle: Habka tijaabada waa bilaash. Si aad u soo saarto sumadaha dhabta ah adigoo isticmaalaya furaha wax-soo-saarka ee EasyPost, ku fur wax-soo-saarka kombuyuutarkan iib hal mar ah.
